Many people "see"
at
shopping
like
an amusement, but I think
it's not always a good translation to give it
. In my opinion
to do
shopping is often
funny
, above all when you can enter
without difficulties
into
a shop
. For

p.s: Many people "see" at shopping like an amusement, but I think it's not always a good translation to give it.
In my opinion to do shopping is often funny, above all when you can enter without difficulties into a shop.
For exemple, if the shop is full of people, is not enjoyable, because they will create too confusion, too noise with the risk of leaving time.
Shopping is a funny thing to do, not when you are in a hurry, but when you have free time and when you can relax yourself.
Another thing that regardes me, is that I enjoy my self more when I know I have to do shopping for me than when it's for my parents or for somebody else!!!
